cohort: Pregnant women above 24 weeks gestational age admitted with or who developed uterine rupture at Ghulam Muhammad Mahar Medical College Hospital Sukkur between January 2018 and December 2020, excluding those with less than 24 weeks gestation or who developed uterine rupture after VBAC in a hospital or were admitted with this complication.
finding: Previous cesarean section was the leading cause of uterine rupture, followed by injudicious use of oxytocin.
